scope: Prospective evidence contract only; sources unchanged, no computation, test, new physical/scientific result or remote issue action.

entries.method: Request synchronized cable tension, supported water inventory, reach/geometry, paid hoist work and attachment state across pickup and release; distinguish carried water from free water.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Configured reachable bag inventory is credited quasi-statically; cable/load/controller dynamics and sample-specific measured support remain unvalidated.

entries.method: Request matched rotor thrust and electrical-input observations by disk area, speed, axial flow and local density, with blade/rotor-speed/pitch policy and thermal/bus state.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Installed cap is an unverified hover surrogate; downward-only authority and constant merit-times-drive-efficiency assumptions do not establish buildable thrust or flight performance.

entries.units: N; m/s; kg/m3; Pa; m2; angle rad
entries.method: Request force-versus-state evidence for matched hull geometry, airspeed, density and attitude; distinguish downforce from induced drag and charge propulsion consistently.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Record basis credits no aerodynamic hold-down; favourable basis uses a capped coefficient. Neither basis supplies an attainable measured force envelope.

entries.method: Request signed broadside force and vertical-velocity observations with registered orientation, area, density and uncertainty across both vertical directions.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Broadside coefficient is unverified; upward-positive velocity fixes sign convention, and applying a positive-only magnitude loses the required signed owner.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Buoyancy minus onboard weight: ledger foundation, not another hold-down owner
entries.units: N; kg; m3; kg/m3; m MSL
entries.method: Request actual displaced volume, complete dry/water/nitrogen inventory and pressure/temperature/altitude basis; compare on the same article and inclusion list.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Local-atmosphere and dry-allowance assumptions do not establish a physical hull. Buoyancy is already in surplus and must not be counted twice.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Horizontal force and propulsion price: outside the vertical owner sum
entries.method: Request matched frontal and induced drag with propulsive electrical input, geometry and airspeed/density/attitude records; include the same aerodynamic downforce state.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Hull drag and propulsion efficiency remain assumed; drag electrical load consumes bus headroom but is not an additional vertical support credit.
